#include <iostream>
#include <vector>

using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 1000000007LL;

int main() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;

    vector<long long> dp(n + 2, 0);
    dp[0] = 1LL;
    long long ans = 0LL;

    for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
        for (int j = i; j <= n; ++j) {
            long long cur = dp[j];
            if (((i + j) & 1) == 1) {
                ans = (ans + cur) % MOD;
            }
            dp[j + 1] = (dp[j + 1] + cur) % MOD;
        }
    }

    cout << ans << endl;

    return 0;
}
